scenarios.name: Multimodal controls ready
scenarios.description: Image and audio controls are visible for an image-and-audio-capable model, an ASR endpoint is selected, and the transcript is empty.

scenarios.name: Image response complete
scenarios.description: A JPG image is rendered in chat with a completed vision-model text response.

scenarios.name: Audio transcribed
scenarios.description: A WAV file is rendered with its transcript and completed model response.

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: A text-only model is selected and both image and audio controls are absent from the DOM.

scenarios.name: No ASR asset
scenarios.description: An audio-capable model is selected, the ASR dropdown is empty, and a registration warning blocks submission.

scenarios.name: File too large
scenarios.description: An oversized image selection is rejected before upload with a size validation error and no preview.

scenarios.name: One media file limit
scenarios.description: One image is already in the conversation and a second media upload is blocked with the one-file limit message.

scenarios.name: Transcription error
scenarios.description: An audio file is attached, the ASR endpoint fails, and an error explains that no model response was requested.

scenarios.name: Endpoints populated
scenarios.description: AI Asset endpoints are loaded and one endpoint is marked ASR-capable.

scenarios.name: No endpoints
scenarios.description: No AI Asset endpoints are registered and the empty state explains how to add one.

scenarios.name: ASR asset registered
scenarios.description: A newly saved Whisper endpoint is marked ASR-capable and a persistent success alert is visible.

scenarios.name: Endpoints load error
scenarios.description: The endpoint table fails to load and a retryable error alert is visible.

scenarios.name: Capability metadata pending
scenarios.description: Endpoints load but capability badges are unavailable and a warning recommends the static fallback.
